jobs.title: Senior Manager, Payer Growth & GTM Strategy
jobs.description:
Point B helps organizations adapt and thrive as technology, AI, and constant disruption reshape how work gets done. For more than 30 years, we’ve connected strategy, execution, and technology so teams, systems, and decisions can move together under pressure. This work helps clients drive growth, improve operational efficiency, and accelerate time to value. We don’t stop at recommendations. We stay with the work through delivery to turn plans into measurable progress and lasting results.
 

Point B is seeking a Senior Strategy Manager to help clients design and execute enterprise growth strategies spanning Product, Service, Marketing, and Sales functions. This role focuses on defining business strategies – enterprise, growth, product/service, and go-to-market. This role is scoped primarily to work within the healthcare Payer industry, bringing foundational understanding of Payer-specific challenges, opportunities and business context.

You will work with senior executives to define/refine business strategies, create business cases to drive decision making, and translate those strategies into actionable transformation roadmaps across the Payer member/customer/employer group lifecycle and/or value streams. This is a business strategy and transformation role, emphasizing growth architecture, product and service strategy, and organizational capability design rather than technical implementation.

As a Strategy Senior Manager, you are responsible for developing others in this area of expertise, directly delivering alongside clients, contributing to growth of a portfolio book of business through thought leadership, solution architecture and driving new sales and relationships.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Strategy Development

- Shape enterprise strategy by identifying growth opportunities, setting strategic priorities, and aligning investments to deliver long-term value.

- Guide organizations in weighing enterprise strategies to progress their vision and goals; develop business cases to drive investment decisions

- Define product and service portfolio strategies aligned to enterprise growth objectives.

- Support product-market fit analysis, pricing and monetization strategy, and value proposition development.

- Shape service offerings and commercialization strategies that improve customer acquisition and retention and position in the marketplace and enable a sustainable growth plan for the enterprise.

- Develop integrated GTM strategies across demand generation, partner ecosystems, sales motions, and customer lifecycle management.

- Define segmentation, targeting, positioning, and messaging strategies supported by data-driven insights.

- Translate growth strategies into executable roadmaps with measurable KPIs.

Capability Assessment & Operating Model Design

- Evaluate enterprise capabilities and architect operating models that align people, processes, and technology to accelerate growth.

- Benchmark organizational capabilities, competitive differentiators, and define future-state operating models.

- Identify capability gaps and develop phased transformation strategies to achieve growth strategies.

Business Development

- Collaborates with Industry and Service Line leadership to evaluate opportunities, sell, and deliver innovative results for new and existing clients.

- Develops thought leadership, client insight articles and represents Point B by presenting at client facing forums and conferences.

- Develops and maintains network at the executive level within healthcare, Payer

- Direct role in business development, supporting generation of  new sales and solution architecture in the business strategy and transformation domain

Core Competencies

- Growth and go-to-market strategy development

- Product and service strategy

- AI-enabled transformation and capability modeling

- Executive facilitation and storytelling

- Business development
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
- 10+ years of experience in strategy consulting, such as growth, product and/or GTM strategy / transformation.

- Experience delivering strategy work in healthcare and/or health insurance/Payer

- Demonstrated experience advising senior stakeholders on growth strategy, product/service strategy, or go-to-market transformation initiatives.

- Proven ability to conduct capability assessments, operating model design, or maturity benchmarking

- Strong business-side understanding of:
Product and service strategy
CRM and customer lifecycle strategy
Lead management and demand generation
AI-enabled business transformation (use-case definition and strategic adoption)

- Exceptional executive communication, structured problem solving, and consulting storytelling skills
DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
- MBA or MSC in Business, Strategy, Marketing, Management, or a related discipline.

- Experience in a high-performing strategy consulting environment or an equivalent corporate strategy function within a Fortune 500 or scaled mid-market organization.

- Ability to architect strategy engagements, develop a portfolio of work and cultivate executive relationships.

- Experience designing or supporting Lead-to-Cash (L2C), Demand-to-Revenue, Product-Led Growth, or AI-enabled GTM initiatives.

- Familiarity with enterprise transformation frameworks (e.g., CVM, ADKAR, Fit-for-Growth, or similar methodologies).

- Experience facilitating executive workshops and building board-level strategy narratives.

- Trained/Certified in relevant areas of expertise, such as MarTech/CRM and/or Consulting Communication & Product Strategy, Digital and AI Strategy, and/or Consulting/Business Agility.
COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:
The estimated salary range for this role is $118,500 - $263,500 USD per year. This salary range is provided as required by local and state law as applicable. Individual salaries vary on a number of factors, including but not limited to geography, skills, education, experience and unique qualifications where applicable.

Bonuses are awarded at Point B’s discretion and are based upon individual contributions and overall firm performance.

Employees hired on or after October 1 are not eligible to participate in the current year’s bonus or merit increase cycle. Eligibility will begin with the following performance cycle, in accordance with company policy

At Point B, you’ll own meaningful work from day one, contribute your perspective, and stay connected to the outcomes you help create. jobs.title: Manager, Financial Planning and Analysis & Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
Point B helps organizations adapt and thrive as technology, AI, and constant disruption reshape how work gets done. For more than 30 years, we’ve connected strategy, execution, and technology so teams, systems, and decisions can move together under pressure. This work helps clients drive growth, improve operational efficiency, and accelerate time to value. We don’t stop at recommendations. We stay with the work through delivery to turn plans into measurable progress and lasting results.

We are seeking an analytical, execution-oriented Finance Manager, Revenue Operations & FP&A to own the processes, systems, and analytics that make Point B’s revenue predictable and our performance visible. Roughly 70% of the role is Revenue Operations: pipeline governance, forecasting operations, Salesforce, and account-planning infrastructure. The remaining 30% is FP&A: annual planning, forecasting, cost planning, and variance analysis.

Point B’s revenue is won through relationships, delivered by consultants on client assignments, and grown through long-term client partnerships. Revenue performance therefore depends on pipeline quality, how quickly sold work becomes staffed assignments, and consultant utilization, not subscription metrics. The successful candidate develops recommendations, executes agreed priorities, and partners closely with market and practice leaders, Business Development, Marketing, Finance, Accounting, Resource Management, and Delivery Operations to create one shared source of truth from opportunity to revenue.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Revenue Operations Responsibilities

-
Own Point B’s pipeline management process, cadence, and reporting, including recurring pipeline reviews with market, practice, and business development leadership.

-
Own the pipeline-based bookings and revenue forecast in partnership with the Business Apps team and Finance, translating open opportunities into expected bookings and revenue timing so leadership can see how pipeline converts into staffed work.

-
Coach sellers and practice leaders on pipeline hygiene, including stage, probability, close date, estimated start date, and engagement value, to improve forecast accuracy.

-
Monitor bookings, pipeline coverage against revenue targets, win rates, and conversion trends, and flag risks and opportunities to leadership.

-
Build and maintain Salesforce dashboards, reports, and account-level views that give sellers and leaders self-service visibility into client metrics such as YTD revenue, bookings, open pipeline, and active assignments.

-
Maintain alignment between Salesforce and downstream financial and resourcing data so that pipeline, bookings, and revenue reconcile.

-
Own the tools, process, reporting, and enablement for account planning and key-client management.

-
Streamline the opportunity-to-assignment lifecycle, including opportunity management, proposal development, SOWs and contracting, handoffs to staffing and delivery, and account expansion.

-
Maintain leadership KPIs and analytics on utilization , bill rates, margins, and client performance, combining Salesforce with financial and resourcing data.

FP&A Responsibilities

-
Manage annual planning data, models, process, and deliverables, partnering with market and practice leaders and Resource Management on revenue, headcount, role-based utilization , and capacity assumptions and targets.

-
Incorporate the pipeline forecast into monthly and quarterly financial forecasts, compare them to actuals, explain variances, and recommend actions.

-
Perform scenario and sensitivity analysis on key drivers such as bookings, utilization , bill rates, and headcount to show leadership the range of potential outcomes.

-
Support G&A and operating cost budgeting, including aligning cost plans to revenue scenarios and tracking actions against plan.

-
Support pricing governance and business performance reviews.

-
Streamline recurring FP&A processes and work with IT and Business Apps to automate reporting where possible.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
-
Bachelor’s degree in Finance , Business, Economics, Analytics, or a related field

-
5 -7 + years of experience in Revenue Operations, FP&A, Business Unit Finance, or Consulting Operations, with hands-on exposure to both revenue operations and financial planning

-
Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, including forecasting, scenario analysis, and variance analysis

-
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex financial and operational information simply to executives

-
Experience managing cross-functional initiatives and process improvements

-
A hands-on, detail-oriented approach that balances accuracy with urgency
DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS
-
Experience with Salesforce CRM, including reports, dashboards, data governance, sales process design, and configuration; Salesforce Administrator certification a plus

-
Experience with Power BI, including data models, DAX, and report development; Tableau or other BI experience also considered

-
Experience in professional services, management consulting, technology consulting, or another project-based services organization, including working knowledge of utilization , bill rates, staffing-driven revenue, and professional services automation (PSA) or resource management systems
COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:
The estimated salary range for this role is $75,500 - $167,500 USD per year. This salary range is provided as required by local and state law as applicable. Individual salaries vary on a number of factors including but not limited to geography, skills, education, experience and unique qualifications where applicable.

Bonuses are awarded at Point B’s discretion and are based upon individual contributions and overall firm performance.

Employees hired on or after October 1 are not eligible to participate in the current year’s bonus or merit increase cycle. Eligibility will begin with the following performance cycle, in accordance with company policy.
